name: Passenger Transport 4
definition: Passenger ticket information for the cardholder.

DocumentNumber.name: Document Number
DocumentNumber.definition: Unique identification number of the document.

ReservationSystem.name: Reservation System
ReservationSystem.definition: Computerised reservation system used to make the reservation and purchase the ticket.

ReservationNumber.name: Reservation Number
ReservationNumber.definition: Value that uniquely identifies the reservation.

OriginalReservationSystem.name: Original Reservation System
OriginalReservationSystem.definition: System code that identifies the original reservation system used to make the reservation and purchase the ticket.

OriginalReservationNumber.name: Original Reservation Number
OriginalReservationNumber.definition: Value that identifies the original reservation generated during the original reservation and purchase of the ticket.

TravelAuthorisationCode.name: Travel Authorisation Code
TravelAuthorisationCode.definition: Contains a code provided to a travel agent by a company to authorise ticket issuance.

TicketIssuer.name: Ticket Issuer
TicketIssuer.definition: Name of the issuing ticket agent.

OpenTicket.name: Open Ticket
OpenTicket.definition: Indicates whether or not the ticket is open or restricted.

CustomerReference.name: Customer Reference
CustomerReference.definition: Contains Customer Reference Values provided for this transaction and used for various reference processing at the customer site. These values represent information most prevalently provided by travel agencies for transactions booked against a lodged account or central travel account.

Passenger.name: Passenger
Passenger.definition: Contains the details of the passenger.

Departure.name: Departure
Departure.definition: Contains departure location, date and time.

Duration.name: Duration
Duration.definition: Duration of the trip in days.

Insurance.name: Insurance
Insurance.definition: Indicates whether or not insurance was purchased.

SummaryCommodityIdentification.name: Summary Commodity Identification
SummaryCommodityIdentification.definition: Provides the identifier assigned by the card acceptor that best categorizes the items being purchased in a standardized commodity group.

TripLeg.name: Trip Leg
TripLeg.definition: Component supports ticketing transactions for airline, railway, and travel agency transactions to provide passenger ticket information for the cardholder. Acquirers can submit multiple occurrences of this component for each airline, railway, or travel agency transaction to provide general ticket information.

AncillaryPurchase.name: Ancillary Purchase
AncillaryPurchase.definition: Contains additional charges related to or during transit (for example, baggage fee, in-flight purchase). These are separate from the original ticket purchase.

HiredVehicleDetails.name: Hired Vehicle Details
HiredVehicleDetails.definition: Vehicle for hire for passenger transport - excludes vehicles driven by a renter.  Examples include, but are not limited to, taxi, chauffeured limousine, boats.

PrivateData.name: Private Data
PrivateData.definition: Reserved for private data. The use of this data element is determined by bilateral agreement.

NationalData.name: National Data
NationalData.definition: Reserved to define data unique to the country applications.
